Shout out to creators of this website. Very interesting information, can't wait to get involved in this.

I'm posting recent charts with marked compressions as well as fresh levels of S&D. I have some experience trading supply and demand (mainly from Sam's webinars and FF) however the compression is new term to me. Hopefully I comprehend this idea of consumed levels leading into a fresh level correctly.

Note: Some of the zones that were too wide were narrowed down by looking at lower time frames.

Any critique is most welcome.

Cheers Elin

posts.t: Attached is the USDCAD D1. The TL represents CP and the extended zone represents unused supply. Metatrader makes it difficult to make notes on charts. But the picture clearly shows a consolidation (large box zone) at the bottom towards demand. See price probing both extremes before deciding to push down to major demand. In which price rocketed pass the consolidation zone which tells us price used up supply in that area making the road clear till the unused supply zones represented by the extended blue zones.
posts.fa: پیوست USDCAD در D1 است. TL نمایندهٔ CP است و ناحیهٔ کشیده‌شده نمایندهٔ عرضهٔ استفاده‌نشده. Metatrader نوشتن یادداشت روی چارت را سخت می‌کند. اما تصویر کاملاً یک تجمیع (ناحیهٔ باکس بزرگ) در پایین به‌سمت تقاضا را نشان می‌دهد. ببین قیمت هر دو انتها را کاوش می‌کند و بعد تصمیم می‌گیرد به‌سمت تقاضای اصلی فشار بیاورد. بعد قیمت از ناحیهٔ تجمیع راکت کرد و رد شد، که به ما می‌گوید قیمت عرضهٔ آن محدوده را مصرف کرده و راه را تا ناحیه‌های عرضهٔ استفاده‌نشده، همان ناحیه‌های آبی کشیده‌شده، باز کرده است.
